sentences.text: The instant Criminal Misc. Petition under Section 528 of the BNSS has been filed on behalf of the petitioner for quashing of the FIR No.52/2025 registered at Police Station Takhatgarh, District Pali for offence punishable under Sections 420 & 406 of IPC.
Learned State Counsel has submitted a factual report dated 30.03.2026 received from SHO, Police Station Takhatgarh, District Pali.
The same is taken on record.
According to the factual report, after thorough investigation, the Police has submitted negative final report in this matter, before the concerned Court.
In view of the above, the prayer made in this petition does not survive anymore and the present Criminal Misc. Petition has become infructuous and the same is dismissed as such.
Stay application and pending application(s), if any, also stand dismissed.
